subject: Article 30 extract & DPIA workshop coordination
messages:
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@everwellhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@everwellhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Article 30 extract, DPIA summary, and audit runbook

Hi Hannah —

We're starting prep for an EU compliance review and our privacy team needs the following from Redwood to complete our intake: a CSV excerpt of your Article 30 register for the Everwell integration (only processors/subprocessors that touch patient tokens), a short DPIA one-pager summarizing key risk mitigations you rely on, and a runbook or checklist for how you would respond to a request to access processing records (sampling approach, pull windows).

Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? We're aiming for a kickoff workshop the week of Mar 15 if possible. Also will the auditor (PwC) need a separate NDA?

Thanks,
Sofia Alvarez
Senior Privacy Manager — Everwell Health
sofia.alvarez@everwellhealth.com

P.S. Please include any retention windows or redaction methods up front so we can scope the request with legal.

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@everwellhealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Article 30 extract, DPIA summary, and audit runbook

Sofia —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the materials you asked for. Quick plan and owners below:

- Art.30 excerpt (CSV): Irene will produce a filtered export limited to processors/subprocessors that interact with the Everwell customer token namespace (owner: Irene, ETA: Mar 12 EOD).
- DPIA one-pager: I will pull our DPIA summary and produce a redacted one-pager highlighting mitigations relevant to Everwell (owner: Hannah, ETA: Mar 12).
- Audit runbook & sampling approach: Marissa will draft a short runbook that details pull windows, sampling methodology, and proof artifacts we can share with auditors (owner: Marissa, ETA: Mar 14).

Attachments I'm dropping into this thread: audit_runbook_v0.1.pdf (draft), pull_window_spec.csv (internal spec). We'll attach a sanitized art30_register_excerpt.csv after Irene's export.

Regarding NDA: yes, auditors will need an NDA. Laura, can Legal draft/respond to Everwell's standard NDA or should we route them to our DocuSign?

Next steps: propose a 60-min workshop on Tue Mar 16 10:00 CET / Mon Mar 15 13:00 PDT to walk the runbook and sample artifact. Sofia, does that work for you and your auditor?

-Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: audit_runbook_v0.1.pdf (PDF, 92KB); pull_window_spec.csv (CSV, 4KB)

From: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Article 30 extract, DPIA summary, and audit runbook

Hannah —

I've pulled a scoped extract from our processing registry and created art30_register_excerpt.csv. Notes:

- The export contains only records where the processor/subprocessor service_id equals the Everwell token namespace.
- We applied PII masking for internal ops team emails (*****@redwoodinference.com) and removed IP addresses per our internal minimization rules.
- Retention windows shown are the operational retention (log retention: 90 days, KV-cache snapshots: 30 days, audit logs: 365 days).

I'll attach the CSV in a follow-up; if the auditor needs raw logs we can provide sampled, time-boxed bundles (see pull_window_spec.csv for the sampling rules).

Irene Choi
Senior Product Compliance Analyst
Redwood Inference

Attachment: art30_register_excerpt.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Article 30 extract, DPIA summary, and audit runbook

Folks —

I've reviewed the scope and have two legal asks before we share artifacts with PwC:

1) We need a countersigned auditor NDA (or our standard auditor addendum) in place. Please ask Everwell to sign the attached auditor_nondisclosure.pdf or send their standard NDA to legal@redwoodinference.com.

2) Narrow the scope to the specific processing elements Everwell needs; we should not share tenant-agnostic logs. The runbook should explicitly call out the clause in our DPA (DPA §7.2 - Audit rights) that permits limited inspection and requires redaction. I'll prepare a short cover letter referencing the DPA clause.

I will also confirm whether the DPIA one-pager needs further redaction for security controls that are confidential (kernel-level performance tuning and some runtime telemetry).

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal — Data & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: auditor_nondisclosure.pdf

From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@everwellhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@pwc.com>, Compliance Team <compliance@everwellhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:00:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Article 30 extract & DPIA workshop coordination

Thanks — confirmed. We can sign Redwood's auditor NDA; sending it now via DocuSign (link below). Workshop time Mar 16 10:00 CET works for PwC and our team.

For the workshop we want to see: the sanitized Art.30 CSV, the DPIA one-pager, and one example sampled pull (time-bound bundle). PwC will limit requests during the session to the scoped artifacts only.

Link: https://www.docusign.com/links/everwell-audit-nda

—Sofia
Sofia Alvarez
Senior Privacy Manager — Everwell Health

Subject: Re: Article 30 extract & DPIA workshop coordination

All —

Summary / next steps before Tue's workshop: 

- Irene: upload art30_register_excerpt.csv to Drive and mark "Everwell - audited copy" (ETA: Mar 15 EOD).
- Hannah: finalize dpia_summary_onepager.pdf with high-level mitigations and redactions (ETA: Mar 15 EOD).
- Marissa: prepare a single sampled pull bundle (time-boxed to a 24-hour window, sanitized) and an excerpt of the supporting audit logs (ETA: Mar 16 morning).
- Laura: we'll circulate the short legal cover letter that references DPA §7.2 and confirms redaction limits before the workshop.
- Sofia / PwC: countersign the NDA via DocuSign; once complete we'll share Drive links and the HubSpot record HS-78321 for tracking.

Attachments to expect: art30_register_excerpt.csv; dpia_summary_onepager.pdf; sampled_pull_bundle (link to Drive will be provided during the workshop).
